_comment: The graphs inside core's `dsa` sub-graph, declared FROM WITHIN (#980) on the pattern of cat-harness's `work-plan/graph.json`. Each entry is `subgraph: true`, a directory of the LAYER listed by `resolveDirectories` with `within: "dsa"`. Paths are relative to THIS directory. OPT-IN (`optIn: true` on its entry): off in every layer unless that layer lists `folio-assistant-core.dsa` in its own `enableSubgraphs` (owner, 2026-11-10, card Q-SG-1 C, wave 1). The `dsa` typology, `check:dsa-hash` and its Tool stay outside it, so a layer that holds a DSA can still declare and check one.
